newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Champalimaud gives some details of BPSM, BTA moves.
newsitem.headline: Champalimaud gives some details of BPSM, BTA moves.

text.p: Portuguese businessman Antonio Champalimaud, whose group controls Banco Pinto & Sotto Maior and Banco Totta & Azores, said that the two would retain separate identities in a group reorganisation.
"BPSM and BTA will continue to have their own presence in the markets in which they operate," he said in a statement.
The reorganisation is aimed at increasing the efficiency of the banking and insurance network, the statement added.
Both banks will take an equal stake in Chemical-SGPS, the holding for Banco Chemical (Portugal) which the group recently bought.
Various areas of activities will be headed by subholdings, including specialised credit, fund management, brokerage, tourism and real estate.
Purchases within the group will be centralised as will the group's trading rooms, it said.
